title: The Latch and Hasp Primer
summary: A first primer for the seal-aligned on closing the qi like a latch and holding a blow or a limb shut with it.

title: A Handbook of Closing Palms
summary: A handbook of open-hand blows and touches that press a seal of qi into the foe and stop the part touched.

title: The Plain Bolt Primer
summary: A primer on throwing the qi across the body like a bolt so a guard stays shut and a blow lands pinned.

title: A Reader in Shut Breath
summary: A reader in holding the breath and the qi closed together so the body gives nothing away and the foe's wind is cut.

title: The Seal and Stopper Course
summary: A course in capping a wound or a limb with a stopper of qi and in the plain palm strokes that set one.

title: A Short Book of Warding Knots
summary: A short book on tying the qi into small knots that guard the body and cinch a foe's limb in place.

title: Primer of the Closed Hand
summary: A primer on the closed fist and the closed guard that give nothing to the foe and keep the qi shut inside.

title: The Holding Fist Handbook
summary: A handbook of fist and forearm work that holds the foe in place and holds the stance against a heavier push.
